name: Olimpbet
verdict: The Olimpbet bookmaker brand is run by ООО «БК «Олимп», 97.5% owned by ООО «Зевс» (Darina Denisova 50%, Andrey Petukhov 50%) and 2.5% by founder Sergey Koziavkin. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: ЕГРЮЛ register data via Rusprofile (archived copies, rusprofile.ru blocks scripts) traces ООО «БК «Олимп» to ООО «Зевс» (97.5%), owned 50/50 by Andrey Petukhov and Darina Denisova, and to director Sergey Koziavkin (2.5%). No state stake and no human-rights finding on the owners or the company found. Official partner of several KHL clubs (CSKA, Severstal, Spartak, Sochi, Amur) per the club sites.
